original_method: Record M.2/fio identity, topology and health; preserve logs; designate disposable non-OS M.2 and authorize overwrite; replace randwrite with bounded randrw/rwmixread=70 plus explicit target/size; validate mapping; run once; capture output/health; leave recovery to owner.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row6 Wistron-Storage-00017-V003: approve the named 70% read/30% write randrw profile (`rwmixread=70`) instead of the literal 100% randwrite job; designate an exact disposable non-OS M.2/NVMe device or namespace with serial/topology mapping and authorize data loss; approve fio binary, target/size/range, raw-versus-filesystem mode, QD1/512B/one-job semantics, 43,200-second or bounded runtime, thresholds/tolerance, NVMe SMART/media/thermal/power abort, cleanup/remount/reinitialization and invalid-run policy.

review_improvement: Prevents a 100%-write stress from masquerading as a 70/30 mixed test and adds namespace-specific destructive safeguards.
independent_technical_reasoning: `rw=randwrite` sends no reads and can exhaust an M.2 device's write cache and raise temperature very differently from a 70%-read mix. Because namespace and controller identities can differ from path names, serial-plus-namespace mapping is necessary to avoid both invalid performance comparison and loss of unrelated data.
